children: Anthropic options haven't been as popular as many expected after they began trading Monday.

Daniel Dolnik, trading lead for U.S. single-stock options at trading firm Optiver, said that volumes for Anthropic options on Tuesday were around a quarter of the levels seen during the second day of trading for SpaceX options. But he added that much of the activity has been bets that Anthropic shares will run higher.
"Retail interest appears to have cooled since the stock dropped below its IPO price," Dolnik said.
